mapper.select: select * from t_product where id = #{id} limit 1 for update
select * from t_product where status = 'ON_SHELF' order by id
mapper.update: update t_product set available_stock = available_stock - #{quantity}, locked_stock = locked_stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 'ON_SHELF' and available_stock >= #{quantity}
